project_type: Vite + React 19 SPA, TanStack Router v1 (file-based routing), Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: Vite 8.1.5 with @tanstack/router-plugin (autoCodeSplitting: true). TanStack Router auto-generates src/routeTree.gen.ts from src/routes/**. NEVER edit routeTree.gen.ts manually — it is regenerated on every save. Add new routes by creating files in src/routes/ and the router plugin will pick them up.
test_framework: No test framework installed. Verification = build passes + dev server renders correctly.
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` from d:\benevolat-connect\frontend. 2) Check that no TypeScript errors appear. 3) Run `npm run dev` and navigate to /dashboard-login, /benevole, /association to confirm pages render.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by the vite router plugin on every build/dev run. Never edit it.
environment_constraints: Windows (pwsh). Dev server default port 5173. Never force-push. routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated, do not touch it. The @tanstack/router-plugin scans src/routes/ — a new file at src/routes/benevole.tsx creates the /benevole route automatically.
contribution_requirements: All UI in French. Fictional data written directly in components (no API calls for dashboard data). Preserve exact visual identity: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque), font-sans (DM Sans), border-2 border-ink, shadow-[3px_3px_0_var(--color-ink)] neo-brutalist style. Use oklch color tokens from styles.css: --mustard, --pink, --emerald, --ink, --paper.
key_patterns: 1) Route layout pattern: src/routes/missions.tsx is a layout with `createFileRoute('/missions')({ component: () => <Outlet /> })`. Children live at missions.index.tsx and missions.$id.tsx. Use same pattern for /benevole and /association. 2) Nested route naming: benevole.index.tsx (dashboard), benevole.explorer.tsx, benevole.carte.tsx etc. Association tabs follow same convention. 3) Color tokens via Tailwind: bg-mustard, bg-pink, bg-emerald, text-ink, bg-paper, bg-muted. 4) Components use `cn()` from @/lib/utils. 5) AuthContext: useAuth() returns { user, token, loginUser, logout }. UserProfile has role: 'BENEVOLE'|'ASSOCIATION'|'ADMIN'. 6) Recharts already installed — use PieChart/Pie, BarChart/Bar, LineChart/Line + ChartContainer from @/components/ui/chart.tsx. 7) Lucide-react for icons. 8) Sonner (sonner package) for toasts — already in @/components/ui/sonner.tsx. 9) @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-progress, @radix-ui/react-slider, @radix-ui/react-switch all available. 10) Skeleton from @/components/ui/skeleton.tsx. 11) Sidebar component exists at @/components/ui/sidebar.tsx (Radix-based, full-featured). 12) MissionMap uses Google Maps. For the new map tab, use react-leaflet (to install) instead since no API key needed. 13) Button variants: default (bg-primary text-primary-foreground), outline, secondary, ghost, destructive.
directory_structure: src/routes/ — file-based routes (TanStack Router). src/components/ui/ — shadcn-style primitives (button, card, badge, dialog, select, table, tabs, skeleton, sidebar, chart, etc.). src/components/site/ — public landing page components + data.ts (mock data). src/components/auth/ — AuthLayout, ImageUpload. src/context/AuthContext.tsx — useAuth() hook. src/lib/utils.ts — cn(). src/styles.css — Tailwind v4 + design tokens.
